intro: Arkansas Legislative Audit examines every county and publishes what it finds. This page quotes what the auditors reported about Arkansas County, from its latest report — no verdict added in either direction. What the auditors said is the record; what to make of it is yours.
regulatory_basis_note: Read this before reading any Arkansas audit: county and city reports carry a technical 'adverse opinion' on GAAP grounds because Arkansas law has them keep books on a simpler 'regulatory basis.' That phrase appears in every such audit in the state and signals the accounting format — not wrongdoing. A report is 'clean' or not in its findings, deficiencies, and noncompliance sections, which is what this page quotes.

verdicts.quote: Noncompliance with state law and accepted accounting practices was noted in the office of County Judge. 501 requires management to obtain a federal compliance audit when federal expenditures exceed $750,000, which occurred in 2023. As of report date, the County had obtained an engagement letter; however, the audit had not been completed. The County could be responsible for repayment of federal expenditures if noncompliance is noted during a federal compliance audit.
verdicts.detail: A limited review (a “financial and compliance report”), not a full audit: the financial statements in it are unaudited. The letter continues in the report on page 3; parts that concern staff positions are left to the report, since this site doesn’t single out non-elected staff.

limits: From the 2024 report, dated August 10, 2026. Read by machine from the report’s text; the quotes are the auditors’ words. Older reports, and the separate federal (single) audits, aren’t on this page yet.
Arkansas alternates between full audits and limited “financial and compliance” reviews; each line says which this is.

cities.name: Humphrey
cities.quote: Noncompliance with state law and accepted accounting practices was noted in the offices of the Mayor and Recorder/Treasurer. Mayor The minutes of the governing body did not document the review of the prior report and accompanying comments, or action taken by governing body, as required by Ark Code Ann. § 10-4-418. Recorder/Treasurer The City has been in negotiations with the Internal Revenue Service (IRS) related to unremitted federal taxes on salaries totaling $1,026,776 paid from 2011 through 2017.
